# Docs for projects by Pratyay Mustafi

> Setup guides, configuration notes, and technical reference for open-source tools by
> Pratyay Mustafi: Drawy and DrawX whiteboards, the ensor secrets CLI, the forgit
> multi-forge CLI, LightCMS, the QCADesigner-E AppImage, and VN Video Editor packaging.
> Built with Zola; pages are Markdown in a public repository at
> https://github.com/Pratyay360/pratyay360.github.io

## Start here

- [Project documentation and guides](https://pratyay360.github.io/): Site introduction and links to every guide.
- [Getting Started with Projects & Tools](https://pratyay360.github.io/started-projects-tools/): Short tour of the projects documented here.
- [Developer Documentation & Guides](https://pratyay360.github.io/developer-documentation-guides/): Featured projects and where to find each guide.

## Guides

- [Drawy: Self Hosted Collaborative Whiteboard](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy/): Setup, sharing, self-hosting on Cloudflare Workers, architecture, and privacy.
- [DrawX: offline whiteboard](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawx-100-private-offline-whiteboard-app/): Offline desktop whiteboard for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- [ensor: Secret Detection & Redaction CLI](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/ensor/): Find hardcoded secrets, redact them, and convert env file formats.

## Project pages

- [forgit: One CLI for GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and More](https://pratyay360.github.io/forgit-a-cli-for-all-the-gitforges/): Unified commands for repos, issues, pull requests, and releases.
- [LightCMS: Git-Based CMS for Static Sites](https://pratyay360.github.io/lightcms/): Front matter editing and publishing backed by Git.
- [QCADesigner-E Power Estimation on Linux](https://pratyay360.github.io/qcadesigner-qca-simulator-power-estimation-linux/): Install the AppImage and run a first power estimate.
- [VN Video Editor on Linux](https://pratyay360.github.io/vn-video-editor-appimage/): Unofficial AppImage packaging via Wine.
- [My Open-Source Toolkit](https://pratyay360.github.io/my-opensource-toolkit/): Short summaries of the tools above and how they fit together.

## Other

- [Privacy](https://pratyay360.github.io/privacy/): Site privacy policy.
- [Blog](https://pratyay.online/): Writing on Linux, Tauri, and infrastructure.
